notes: All 79 cards compared with Netter 7e H&N muscle tables (p. 219-224), Back muscle tables (p. 270-271) and plates 31-37, 55-56, 67, 70-71, 75-81, 91-94, 96, 101, 107, 133-140. Blood supply added for 71 cards; the 8 existing blood-supply values were checked and 4 expanded (masseter, SCM, trapezius, intrinsic tongue). Netter has no table rows for superior tarsal, aryepiglottic, thyroepiglottic, semispinalis capitis/cervicis or longissimus capitis specifically; their blood supply entries are marked netter-inferred (from the levator palpebrae, arytenoid/thyroarytenoid, generic semispinalis and erector spinae rows). Netter's longus colli inferior-oblique insertion (anterior tubercles C3-C6) and scalene segmental levels (anterior and posterior C5-C8, middle C3-C7) differ from Gray's; corrections follow Netter per instructions but the editor may wish to keep a note. Zygomaticus major/minor origins are given by Netter simply as 'zygomatic arch'; proposed wording keeps the card's detail while matching Netter. Netter's thyroarytenoid row lists 'sphincter of vestibule' as an action; the thyroepiglottic card's long contested-action text was left unchanged because Netter gives no separate action for that part, but the editor may want to trim its in-text citations. Netter groups the auricular muscles as 'External ear' and palatoglossus as 'Palatal' (card groups left alone). Pearls were checked against the clinical tables (p. 216-218): genioglossus, levator veli palatini/uvula, superior tarsal and CN XI pearls agree; no pearl corrections. Grouped cards cover Netter's separate rows for auricularis anterior/superior/posterior, rectus capitis posterior major/minor and obliquus capitis superior/inferior, and the four intrinsic lingual muscles, so those are not listed as missing.
